title: Per-tenant runway & GPU slice forecast (Dec 2026)
content:
Purpose:
This working sheet estimates per-tenant GPU slice runway across regions for Dedicated contracts starting Jan 2027. It helps negotiation (sales), on-call capacity planning (SRE/infra), and pre-allocations for committed pools. NOT final - uses conservative utilization signals from Oct-Nov 2026 logs and last-quarter commit changes.

Legend / assumptions:
- 'Slice' (GPU) = 1 x A100-80GB-equivalent slot. We normalize other types to A100-80GB eq using perf-factor.
- Perf-factor: A100-80GB=1.0, A100-40GB=0.6, H100=1.15 (applied where vendor mix specified).
- Forecast horizon: 90 days from contract start (month-of-start granularity).
- Safety buffer: default 10% of committed slice count unless SLA=gold then 5%.
- AvgUtil = expected average steady-state GPU utilization across requests (0-100%).

Table (columns):
ContractID | Customer | Region | GPU_Type | Committed_Slices | Buffer(%) | Start | End | AvgUtil(%) | Projected_GPU_days_per_month | Notes
C-1847 | NovaSearch | us-west1 | H100 | 48 | 10 | 2027-01-01 | 2027-12-31 | 72 | =48*30*0.72 -> 1036.8 | Heavy token gen; can burst to public pool if <60% headroom
C-1988 | FinLedger | eu-west1 | A100-80GB | 16 | 5 | 2027-01-15 | 2028-01-14 | 85 | =16*30*0.85 -> 408 | SLA: gold, reduced buffer
C-2024 | EduBright | asia-east1 | A100-40GB (0.6) | 24 (=>14.4 eq) | 10 | 2027-02-01 | 2027-08-01 | 45 | =14.4*30*0.45 -> 194.4 | seasonal (classroom peaks M-F)
C-2102 | RetailMax | us-east1 | A100-80GB | 64 | 10 | 2027-01-01 | 2029-01-01 | 60 | =64*30*0.60 -> 1152 | planned model sharding, high infer throughput
C-2119 | HealthCo | us-west1 | H100 | 8 | 10 | 2027-03-01 | 2028-03-01 | 40 | =8*30*0.40 -> 96 | HIPAA, Private deployment flag -> dedicated VPC

Monthly regional summary (normalized to A100-80GB eq):
- us-west1: committed_eq = 48(H100->55.2) + 8(H100->9.2) = 64.4 eq (note perf-factor applied)
- us-east1: committed_eq = 64
- eu-west1: committed_eq = 16
- asia-east1: committed_eq = 14.4 (normalized)
Total committed_eq = 158.8 eq -> with default buffers (+10%) = 174.7 eq required pool by Jan 2027

Available fleet snapshot (as of 2026-12-01, normalized eq):
- us-west1: fleet_total_eq = 180 -> allocated_to_dedicated = 70 -> free_pool = 110
- us-east1: fleet_total_eq = 140 -> allocated_to_dedicated = 90 -> free_pool = 50
- eu-west1: fleet_total_eq = 80 -> allocated_to_dedicated = 30 -> free_pool = 50
- asia-east1: fleet_total_eq = 40 -> allocated_to_dedicated = 20 -> free_pool = 20

Headroom analysis and flags:
- Global: total required (with buffers) 174.7 eq vs total free_pool across regions 230 -> OK on aggregate but mismatched regionally.
- us-west1: current planned demand (64.4 eq) vs free_pool 110 -> OK, but note two gold contracts (FinLedger in eu-west1 is gold; us-west1 has one gold? check SLA tags)
- us-east1: high committed allocation (64) plus reserve allocations -> free_pool 50 -> risk of preemption if public bursts >30%. Consider re-routing lower-SLO customers to us-west1 or eu-west1.
- asia-east1: limited free_pool (20) vs normalized demand 14.4 eq -> tight but acceptable; consider prewarming extra nodes 7 days prior to EduBright start windows.

Short action items (owner tags):
- [Maya] Reconcile perf-factors with infra/benchmarks (PR #214) -> block: confirm H100->A100 eq mapping under v1.2 telemetry (due 2026-12-12).
- [Arjun] Draft temporary re-route policy for us-east1 (lower-cost reroute to us-west1) and update smart-routing RBAC flags. (Jira INFR-4321)
- [Liam] Validate private VPC attachments for HealthCo and add KMS keys to Secrets manager (due 2027-01-10).
- [Noah] Add EduBright scheduled scale policy and prewarm script to release-engineering playbook.

Risks / open questions:
- We currently assume steady AvgUtil per contract; early telemetry shows 25% variance for generation-heavy customers (C-1847). If AvgUtil spikes, projected GPU-days will increase and headroom could be exhausted in 7-10 days for us-west1.
- H100 vendor deliveries for Jan are only 70% confirmed; if delayed, we must fallback to mixed A100 pool and apply lower perf-factor -> impacts total_committed_eq calculation.
- Should we allow cross-region elastic bursting for gold SLAs? Legal/compliance (HealthCo) may restrict geographic movement.

Notes for sales / commercial ops:
- Use "Projected_GPU_days_per_month" as negotiation anchor for add-on pricing. Example: RetailMax committed 64 slices -> equivalent monthly billable units = 1152 GPU-days/month (apply billing multiplier for high-SLA).
- Offer FinLedger a 3% discount for locking start date to 2027-01-01 instead of 2027-01-15 (saves prewarm overhead).

Appendix - quick calc examples:
- Formula: Projected_GPU_days_per_month = Committed_Slices_eq * 30 * (AvgUtil/100).
- Example C-2102: 64 * 30 * 0.6 = 1152 GPU-days.

Revision history:
- 2026-12-07 Maya Chen: initial draft with normalized table and early fleet snapshot.
- 2026-12-09 Arjun Patel: updated perf-factors & added action items, linked INFR-4321
